items.example: When's dinner? I'm starving!
items.exampleTr: Akşam yemeği ne zaman? Açlıktan ölüyorum!
items.simple: You are very, very hungry.

items.example: Wow, it smells amazing in here!
items.simple: The smell is so good that you want to eat it.

items.example: Can you chop the onions for me?
items.simple: You cut food into small pieces with a knife.

items.example: Boil the eggs for ten minutes.
items.simple: You heat water until it bubbles.

items.example: I'll fry some eggs for breakfast.
items.simple: You cook food in hot oil in a pan.

items.example: We baked a cake for her birthday.
items.simple: You cook cakes or bread inside a hot oven.

items.example: Keep stirring or it will burn.
items.simple: You move a spoon round and round in the food.

items.example: Can you give me the recipe?
items.simple: A paper that tells you how to make a food.

items.example: We're missing one ingredient.
items.simple: One of the things you put in a food when you cook.

items.example: We had leftovers for lunch.
items.simple: The food that is still there after dinner.

items.example: I'm too tired to cook. Let's order in.
items.exampleTr: Yemek yapmak için çok yorgunum. Sipariş verelim.
items.simple: You ask a restaurant to bring the food to your door.

items.example: Cut up the apples for the kids.
items.simple: You cut something into smaller pieces.

items.example: I'll heat up the soup.
items.simple: You make cold food warm again.

items.example: This soup is really tasty.
items.simple: Food that has a very nice taste.

items.example: This chicken is still raw.
items.simple: Food that you did not cook yet.

items.example: I need a strong coffee this morning.
items.exampleTr: Bu sabah sert bir kahveye ihtiyacım var.
items.simple: A coffee with a very big taste that wakes you up.

items.example: We eat too much fast food.
items.simple: Food that comes to you very quickly, like burgers.

items.example: There's plenty of food. Help yourself!
items.simple: You tell someone to take food by themselves.

items.example: No more, thanks. I'm full.
items.simple: Your tummy has enough food. You can't eat more.

items.en: Could I have the bill, please?
items.example: Could I have the bill, please?
items.simple: You ask for the paper that says how much to pay.

items.example: Add a pinch of salt and stir.
items.exampleTr: Bir tutam tuz ekle ve karıştır.
items.simple: Put in a very small bit of something.

items.example: Can I have a slice of cake?
items.simple: One thin piece cut from a bigger food.

items.example: Come on, dinner's ready!
items.simple: The food is done. Come and eat.

items.example: Can you peel the potatoes?
items.simple: You take the skin off a fruit or vegetable.
